audio_stress.description: Synthetic multi-kill/drowning cues on the real context, separate from visual/host stages

previous_test_failure_fixed.reason: A legitimate four-tick catch-up sent five frames including the overlap; the existing test assumed no more than four. Replaced the wall-clock length assumption with contiguous bounded history checks and an exact deterministic four-tick overlap regression. No server behavior changed.

limits: Controlled latency figures sample the presentation model at 60 Hz using actual App, Connection, Timeline, Prediction and Match code; they are not physical input-to-photon or acoustic measurements.
Linux rendering tail outliers exceeded the existing strict 60 ms gate with prediction enabled, disabled and untouched 0.5.6; their root cause is not established.

The final Apple silicon packaged rendering capture also exceeded that gate: combat mean 16.20 ms, p95 21.08 ms, max 98.27 ms. The informational step failed despite the workflow overall reporting success; required gameplay and recovery checks passed.

Rope, jetpack, parachute, weapons, damage and terrain remain server-driven. Prediction falls back for stale state/terrain, RTT at least 400 ms or commands unacknowledged longer than 400 ms. Replay is bounded to 12 ticks and 96 commands.
The 800 ms downstream outage produces the same 37 playback underruns with prediction on or off; prediction does not remove the underlying playback buffer limits.
Human Apple silicon playtesting is still needed to judge input feel, visible corrections, physical display behavior and audible output.
